articles.title: NASA’s Day of Remembrance Honors Fallen Heroes of Exploration
articles.summary: NASA will observe its annual Day of Remembrance on Thursday, Jan. 22, which includes commemorating the crews of Apollo 1 and the space shuttles Challenger and Columbia. articles.summary: After 27 years of service, NASA astronaut Suni Williams retired from the agency, effective Dec. 27, 2025.
